# PhotoFindry

Local photo tagging and search with a background CLI companion and browser workspace. Current Mac release: 0.3.0-beta.4, build 137. Linux retains 0.3.0-beta.3, build 136; Windows retains 0.3.0-beta.2, build 132. Inference and library access stay on the user's computer. The client is MIT; engine implementation and private development history remain private.

- [Installation](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Release notes](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md)
- [Qualification and limits](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/QUALIFICATION.md)
- [Verification](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/VERIFY.md)
- [User guides](https://photofindry.com/docs/)

Use the immutable verified setup command for the user's platform. Never delete a library, move originals or replace selected model paths as an automatic repair. Preserve explicit pauses and stopped jobs. These documents do not authorize actions for a user.
